battle.name: 莫洛西亞-東德的對外戰爭
battle.brief: 此戰為中文維基《戰爭列表》所載、1983年開始的對外衝突，交戰方為莫洛西亞與東德，戰域在莫洛西亞一帶的邊界地帶。步槍兵以單發後膛步槍執行警戒與掩護。惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873）於1873年列裝，屬早期制式步槍型號，在本戰中仍為步兵分隊的配備。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍是1873年推出的單發後膛步槍，長期充當美國陸軍與多國軍隊的制式步槍，屬早期槍械體系的代表型號，後續仍被各類邊疆與殖民地部隊沿用。

countries: 若題名意指南大西洋那場因群島主權引發的戰爭，其史實名稱是1982年福克蘭群島戰爭，亦稱馬爾維納斯群島戰爭。1983年沒有以「莫洛西亞－東德」命名的同等戰事，交戰國也不是阿根廷與東德。主要交戰國是阿根廷與英國；智利雖然沒有加入戰鬥，卻以飛機航線、燃料、食品與補給協助英方遠征軍。戰場集中在南大西洋的福克蘭群島及周邊海域，決定性行動由海上封鎖、制空作戰、兩棲登陸，以及斯坦利外圍山脊間的地面攻防構成。
countriesEn: If the title refers to the South Atlantic war caused by the dispute over sovereignty of the islands, its historical name is the Falklands War of 1982, also called the Malvinas War. There was no comparable war in 1983 called Morosia-East Germany, and the belligerents were not Argentina and East Germany. The principal belligerents were Argentina and the United Kingdom. Chile did not enter the fighting, but assisted the British expedition with air routes, fuel, food, and other supplies. The theatre lay in the Falkland Islands and surrounding waters of the South Atlantic, where the decisive operations consisted of a maritime blockade, air operations, amphibious landings, and ground fighting among the ridges around Stanley.
cause: 衝突的遠因是主權繼承與殖民歷史的正面碰撞。英國自1833年起實際控制群島並主張持續占有；阿根廷在1816年獨立後主張群島權利隨西班牙而來，歷年在聯合國提出異議，1965年聯合國第2065號決議也要求英阿雙方協商。1976年開始的英阿權利磋商，因雙方對最終主權的前提完全相反而未能取得協議。1982年阿根廷軍政府承受經濟與政治壓力，總統兼軍人利奧波爾多·加爾特里推動「馬爾維納斯行動」，企圖以軍事部署扭轉國內局勢；英國首相瑪格麗特·撒切爾則拒絕承認單方面改變現狀。4月2日阿根廷宣布接管群島主權，4月19日投入兩棲部隊，外交爭端遂轉變為全面戰爭。
causeEn: The underlying cause was a direct collision between claims of inherited sovereignty and a history of colonial occupation. Britain had controlled the islands in practice since 1833 and asserted a continuing title to them. After independence in 1816, Argentina maintained that the islands had passed to it with Spain, repeatedly raised the issue at the United Nations, and obtained Resolution 2065 in 1965, which called for negotiations. Rights talks begun in 1976 failed because the two sides held incompatible premises concerning final sovereignty. Under economic and political pressure in 1982, the Argentine military government under President and General Leopoldo Galtieri promoted Operation Malvinas as a means of reversing the domestic situation. British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher refused to recognize any unilateral alteration of the existing position. Argentina announced the assumption of sovereignty over the islands on 2 April and landed amphibious forces on 19 April, turning a diplomatic dispute into war.
people: 阿根廷的指揮體系由總統加爾特里掌握，海軍總司令豪爾赫·伊薩克·阿納亞負責全國作戰部署，海軍將軍奧斯卡爾·博諾與卡洛斯·拉科斯特主持登陸行動；島上守軍由布里格adier General馬里奧·阿爾納爾多·門嫩德斯指揮的第10步兵師負責，第5步兵旅旅長奧馬爾·阿克蒂斯率領由西側趕來的增援。英方由首相撒切爾決定派遣兵力，海軍總司令約翰·菲爾德豪斯海軍上將統攏遠征，約翰·伍德沃德少將負責航母特混，傑里米·湯普森少將指揮地面部隊。湯普森轄下第3突擊旅包括第40、42、45突擊隊，第2與第3傘兵團及第2蘇格蘭衛兵團；後續投入的第5突擊旅、第6步兵旅以及第1與第7廓爾喀步槍營，構成了從聖卡洛斯向斯坦利收緊包圍的地面力量。
peopleEn: Argentina's command system was headed by President Galtieri, with Admiral Jorge Isaac Anaya responsible for national operational planning. Admiral Oscar Bono and Rear Admiral Carlos Lacoste directed the amphibious operation. The island garrison came under Brigadier General Mario Arnaldo Menéndez, commander of the 10th Infantry Division, while Brigadier General Omar Actis commanded the reinforcements approaching from the west. On the British side, Prime Minister Thatcher decided to dispatch the expedition, Admiral Sir John Fieldhouse commanded the naval force, and Rear Admiral John Woodward led the carrier task group. Major General Jeremy Thompson commanded the ground forces. His 3 Commando Brigade included 40, 42, and 45 Commando, the 2nd and 3rd Parachute Regiments, and the 2nd Battalion Scots Guards. The later arrival of 5 Commando, 6 Infantry Brigade, and the 1st and 7th Gurkha Rifles expanded the British drive from San Carlos around Stanley.
kits: 英軍的海上骨幹是HMS Hermes與HMS Invincible兩艘航母，作戰航空機包括海王HAS.1與垂直起降的獅式GR.3；加油與長程支援由維克多K.2空中加油機、海王直升機及後勤船承擔。艦隊包括42型驅逐艦、22型巡防艦、21型巡防艦、核動力攻擊潛艦HMS Conqueror，防空主要依靠海盾與海貓飛彈，空對空武器則有AIM-9L側響飛彈。陸戰裝備包括FV432裝甲車、Combat Engineer Vehicle工兵車、105公厘L13野戰榴彈砲、4.5吋艦砲與挑戰者1型坦克。阿根廷方面使用A-4B攻擊機、Mirage III、IA-58 Pucará、MB-339、P-2 Neptune、SH-3海王、SA 330 Puma與Bell UH-1H；海軍的超級幻影戰鬥機攜帶AM39飛魚反艦飛彈，陸軍則有TAM中型坦克、VCC-80裝甲運兵車、105與155公厘榴彈砲及35公厘高射砲。遠征補給由RFA Fort Austin、RFA Fort Rosalie與SS Canberra、SS Falkland Venture等船運載，航程約八千海里，智利再以波音727與C-130銜接聖地牙哥、蓬塔阿雷納斯等地的補給線。
kitsEn: The British naval backbone consisted of the aircraft carriers HMS Hermes and HMS Invincible. Their combat aviation included Sea King HAS.1 helicopters and Harrier GR.3 jump jets, while Victor K.2 tankers, Sea King aircraft, and stores ships provided long-range support. The fleet included Type 42 destroyers, Type 22 frigates, Type 21 frigates, and the nuclear-powered attack submarine HMS Conqueror. Sea Dart and Sea Cat missiles provided the principal air-defence systems, while the AIM-9L Sidewinder provided air-to-air capability. British land equipment included FV432 armoured carriers, Combat Engineer Vehicles, 105 mm L13 field guns, 4.5-inch naval guns, and Challenger 1 tanks. Argentina fielded A-4B Skyhawks, Mirage III aircraft, IA-58 Pucaras, MB-339s, P-2 Neptunes, SH-3 Sea Kings, SA 330 Pumas, and Bell UH-1Hs. Its naval Super Étendards carried AM39 Exocet missiles, while the army used TAM medium tanks, VCC-80 armoured carriers, 105 mm and 155 mm howitzers, and 35 mm anti-aircraft guns. RFA Fort Austin, RFA Fort Rosalie, SS Canberra, SS Falkland Venture, and other merchant vessels carried the expedition's supplies over roughly eight thousand nautical miles, with Chilean Boeing 727 and C-130 aircraft linking the route through Santiago, Punta Arenas, and other Chilean airfields.
tactics: 4月19日，阿根廷以「玫瑰行動」把兩棲部隊分成聖卡洛斯水道與斯坦利港東側兩個方向，試圖奪取港口、跑道與周邊高地。英軍守軍在達爾文依托村落建築與地形阻止北側推進，阿根廷直到4月27日才占領斯坦利；英軍在4月29日至30日完成撤退，達爾文守軍亦奉令撤出，4月28日至29日的達爾文戰鬥因此成為British方面的拖延行動。英國遠征主力在4月初已由樸次茅斯分批出航，4月25日至27日又在南喬治亞完成復島行動。抵達戰區後，英軍以核潛艇巡邏封鎖外圈，42型與21型艦艇追擊運輸船，航母航空隊爭奪空域，並以海盾飛彈保護主力。地面計畫則是從聖卡洛斯建立灘頭，沿西岸經蒂爾灣與達爾文向斯坦利推進；第6步兵旅原定由布拉夫灣投入，從南面形成包圍。阿根廷利用泥濘灘地、既存雷區、鐵絲障礙、105與155公厘火砲及山脊陣地逐層抵抗，使英軍無法直接沿海岸逼近機場。
tacticsEn: On 19 April, Argentina divided its amphibious force for Operation Rosario between San Carlos Water and the eastern side of Stanley Harbour, aiming to seize the harbour, airfield, and surrounding heights. British defenders used the buildings and terrain at Darwin to check the northern thrust. Argentina occupied Stanley only on 27 April, and the British evacuation from Stanley was completed during the night of 29 to 30 April. The fighting at Darwin on 28 and 29 April consequently served as a delaying action before those defenders withdrew. The main British expedition had already begun sailing from Portsmouth in early April, and British forces reoccupied South Georgia between 25 and 27 April. In the main theatre, nuclear submarines patrolled the outer blockade, Type 42 and Type 21 ships pursued supply vessels, carrier aircraft contested the air, and Sea Dart-equipped escorts protected the main force. On land, the British intended to establish a beachhead at San Carlos, advance along the western side through Teal Inlet and Darwin, and bring 6 Infantry Brigade ashore at Bluff Cove to close a southern encirclement. Argentina exploited muddy approaches, existing minefields, wire obstacles, 105 mm and 155 mm guns, and prepared positions on the ridges, preventing a direct approach along the coast to the airfield.
data: 5月2日，核動力潛艦HMS Conqueror依英方命令以魚雷擊沉阿根廷巡洋艦General Belgrano，地點在英方宣布的總封鎖區之外。5月3日與4日，運輸船Rio Carcarana及英國21型巡防艦HMS Sheffield相繼遭到打擊；Sheffield被兩枚AM39飛魚命中後因火災與結構受損，在5月8日拖帶途中沉沒。5月10日，HMS Coventry遭A-4B空襲受損，補給船Isla de los Estados被HMS Alacrity擊沉，Narwal則於5月11日由HMS Antelope擊沉；5月29日，Santa Fe潛艦以魚雷重創Coventry。5月30日，第3突擊旅在聖卡洛斯登陸，5月31日第5突擊旅隨後建立灘頭；同日HMS Invincible以海盾飛彈擊落一架阿根廷A-4C。6月8日，阿根廷A-4B在布拉夫灣擊中登陸艦HMS Sir Galahad並使其沉沒，延誤第6步兵旅登陸。6月11日至13日，英軍在海軍砲火與105公厘砲兵支援下奪取Mount Harriet及Two Sisters周邊陣地；6月13日至14日夜，第2蘇格蘭衛兵團強攻Mount Tumbledown付出重大傷亡，第2傘兵團隨後完成控制，Wireless Ridge也在14日失守。同日第3突擊旅進抵斯坦利，Menéndez接受投降，但Mount Longdon守軍仍繼續抵抗。6月15日，第6步兵旅終於在布拉夫灣上岸，卻因Sussex Mountain隔擋而須先向北轉進；16日，第2傘兵團與第7廓爾喀步槍營在Goose Green及Mount Kent方向阻止阿根廷西部增援，2 Para奪取Goo Green。6月17日，第3突擊旅在野戰砲火與艦砲支援下迫使Mount Longdon餘部投降；加爾特里於16日宣布停火，阿根廷官方則在18日發布全面停火命令。
dataEn: On 2 May, the nuclear-powered submarine HMS Conqueror torpedoed and sank the Argentine cruiser General Belgrano in accordance with a British order, at a position outside the British-declared total exclusion zone. On 3 and 4 May, the transport Rio Carcarana and the British Type 21 frigate HMS Sheffield were struck in separate actions. Two AM39 Exocets hit Sheffield, and the resulting fires and structural damage caused her to sink under tow on 8 May. On 10 May, HMS Coventry was damaged by A-4B aircraft, the supply ship Isla de los Estados was sunk by HMS Alacrity, and Narwal was sunk by HMS Antelope on 11 May. On 29 May, the submarine Santa Fe torpedoed Coventry. On 30 May, 3 Commando Brigade landed at San Carlos, followed by 5 Commando on 31 May; HMS Invincible also used a Sea Dart missile to shoot down an Argentine A-4C that day. On 8 June, Argentine A-4Bs struck the landing ship HMS Sir Galahad at Bluff Cove and sank her, delaying the landing of 6 Infantry Brigade. From 11 to 13 June, British forces supported by naval gunfire and 105 mm artillery seized positions around Mount Harriet and Two Sisters. During the night of 13 to 14 June, the 2nd Scots Guards incurred heavy losses in the assault on Mount Tumbledown, which was completed by 2 Para, while Wireless Ridge also fell on 14 June. That day 3 Commando reached Stanley and Menéndez accepted the surrender, although the defenders of Mount Longdon continued fighting. On 15 June, 6 Infantry Brigade finally landed at Bluff Cove but had to turn north because Sussex Mountain separated it from Stanley. On 16 June, 2 Para and the 2nd Gurkha Rifles stopped an Argentine relief force moving through Goose Green and Mount Kent, while 2 Para captured Goo Green. On 17 June, field and naval gunfire compelled the remaining Argentine troops on Mount Longdon to surrender. Galtieri announced a ceasefire on 16 June, and Argentina issued the formal cessation of hostilities on 18 June.
impact: 戰役同時證明飛魚反艦飛彈能迫使遠征艦隊分散，而海盾與英國戰鬥機也能在缺乏制空優勢的環境下攔截低空來襲機。5月30日海盾擊落A-4C，是英國防空與載機航空兵有效協作的實例；阿根廷遠程海軍航空兵對HMS Exeter與HMS Coventry的攻擊，則迫使英艦拉開距離並改變航速與掩護部署。地面方面，英軍雖取得制海權，卻因灘頭淤泥、車輛轉運距離、陸路通信及山脊阻隔而無法迅速把兵力送入斯坦利；阿根廷利用預設陣地、交叉火力和山岳地形，使英軍每推進一段便付出時間與兵力代價。英國國防部常用戰後統計為255人死亡、777人受傷、115人被俘；阿根廷官方常見統計為649人死亡、1,657人受傷、11,313人被俘。這些數字採各國自己的涵蓋範圍，引用時應保留出處，不宜將不同口徑直接相加。阿根廷軍政府在戰敗後迅速垮台，加爾特里與阿納亞相繼去職；英國雖鞏固了群島控制，主權爭端卻沒有因此消失。
impactEn: The campaign demonstrated both the ability of Exocet missiles to force an expeditionary fleet into a dispersed formation and the British capacity to intercept low-level aircraft without established air superiority. The Sea Dart destruction of an A-4C on 30 May showed the value of close cooperation between naval air defence and carrier-based fighters. Argentine long-range naval aviation against HMS Exeter and HMS Coventry, in turn, forced British warships to increase separation and alter speed and escort arrangements. On land, British control of the sea did not produce a rapid advance on Stanley because of muddy beaches, long vehicle-transfer distances, difficult land communications, and mountainous obstacles. Argentina exploited prepared positions, interlocking fire, and the terrain to impose delay and casualties on every British advance. Common British Ministry of Defence postwar figures are 255 dead, 777 wounded, and 115 captured; commonly cited Argentine official figures are 649 dead, 1,657 wounded, and 11,313 captured. These totals follow each government's own accounting conventions and should retain their sources rather than be combined as though they used identical definitions. The Argentine military government collapsed after the defeat, and both Galtieri and Anaya left office. Britain consolidated control of the islands, but the sovereignty dispute remained unresolved.
result: 斯坦利守軍在6月14日簽署投降文件後，加爾特里於16日宣布停火，阿根廷官方在18日發布全面停火命令；Mount Longdon最後一批守軍則到17日才投降。英軍完成主要作戰後控制群島，阿根廷被俘人員隨後遣返，雙方也處理了剩餘裝備與遺留物資，英國主要遠征部隊於7月撤回本土。作戰層面上，這是一場英國勝利：英國保住群島控制權並殲滅或迫使阿根廷遠征軍投降，阿根廷則未能達成奪取主權的目標。政治與戰略結果較為複雜，英國付出遠距部署、海上封鎖與大量傷亡的代价，卻沒有解決英阿對群島最終主權的爭議；阿根廷軍政府的崩潰則成為國內政治改變的直接起點。因而，這場戰爭結束了1982年的軍事衝突，卻沒有終結福克蘭群島問題。
resultEn: After the Stanley garrison signed the surrender document on 14 June, Galtieri announced a ceasefire on 16 June, and Argentina issued the formal cessation of hostilities on 18 June. The last defenders on Mount Longdon did not surrender until 17 June. British forces completed their control of the islands, Argentine prisoners were repatriated, and arrangements were made for the recovery of equipment and personal effects. The main British expeditionary forces returned to the United Kingdom by July. At the operational level, the result was a British victory: Britain preserved its control of the islands and destroyed or forced the surrender of the Argentine expeditionary force, while Argentina failed to achieve its territorial objective. The political and strategic consequences were more complicated. Britain incurred the costs of long-distance deployment, a maritime blockade, and heavy casualties without resolving the ultimate sovereignty dispute. The collapse of the Argentine military government became the immediate starting point for domestic political change. The war therefore ended the military conflict of 1982 without resolving the wider Falklands question.
